attributes.name: icon_implementation
attributes.definition: How icons and decorative glyphs (arrows, carets, stars) are rendered on the page.

values.definition: Icons and marks are Unicode/text characters, no SVG.
Icons are inline or referenced SVG graphics.
Icons come from an icon font or raster images.

attributes.name: text_character_restrictions
attributes.definition: Whether the copy avoids certain characters such as emoji or em dashes.

values.definition: Text contains neither emoji nor em dashes.
Em dashes appear in the text.

attributes.name: text_only_section_presence
attributes.definition: Whether the page includes sections composed solely of text and a button with no imagery.

values.definition: Some sections contain only eyebrow, heading, subline and button, with no imagery.
Every section includes imagery or graphics.
